svg.title: Economic offset, recognized capital, and legal finality are distinct
svg.desc: A three-layer model separates economic payoff offset, a named authority's recognized margin model, and enforceable netting and finality. Each layer has additional conditions and cannot be inferred from the layer below.
svg.text: Offset is not recognition. Recognition is not finality.
The three layers are separately governed and must each be evidenced in context.
same declared domain · candidate portfolio · explicit residual
named authority · account/entity · model/version · haircut · liquidation horizon
the authority may deny, cap, or change recognition despite economic offset
jurisdiction · close-out netting · customer protection · default process · finality domain
technical transfer does not establish legal discharge
A STATEBOOK CAN REPORT THE GAP. IT DOES NOT GRANT MARGIN, CLEARING, OR LEGAL AUTHORITY.
